knowledge_point.title: Solving for Three Coefficients in a Linear Combination

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ -4\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 0 \\ 5\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ -4\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{2} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 0 \\ 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ -4\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ x_{2} \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ -1 \\ -4\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-2 \\ x_{2} &=-1 \\ x_{1} + x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=-4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -4\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 1 & 5 & -4\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 & -2\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & 0\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-2 \\ x_{2} &=-1 \\ x_{3} &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=0.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(0)(0)=-1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-1
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-1)(-1)+(2)(0)=-2\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=-3
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=-3$, $x_2=-1$, $x_3=0$, which means

$$
-3a_1+(-1)a_2+(0)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(-3)+(-1)+(0)=-4.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 4 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 4 \\ 6\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ 2 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ x_{2} \\ - x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{3} \\ 0\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 4 \\ 6\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} + x_{3} \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} \\ 2 x_{1} - x_{2}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ 4 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{3} &=-3 \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=4 \\ 2 x_{1} - x_{2} &=6\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 6\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 2 & -1 & 0 & 6\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & 12\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-2)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 16\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(1)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(- \frac{1}{4}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{3} &=-3 \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=4 \\ x_{3} &=-4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=-4.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-2)(-4)=4\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-4
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(0)(-4)+(1)(-4)=-3\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=1
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=1$, $x_2=-4$, $x_3=-4$, which means

$$
1a_1+(-4)a_2+(-4)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(1)+(-4)+(-4)=-7.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ -8 \\ 6\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -10 \\ 8\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ -8 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -10 \\ 8\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 3 x_{1} \\ - 2 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- 3 x_{2} \\ - 8 x_{2} \\ 6 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 5 x_{3} \\ - 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -10 \\ 8\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{1} - 8 x_{2} + 5 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ -10 \\ 8\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-4 \\ 3 x_{1} - 8 x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=-10 \\ - 2 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &=8\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & -4 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & -10 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 8\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & -4 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & -10 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 8\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 8\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-3)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=-4 \\ x_{2} - x_{3} &=2 \\ x_{3} &=0\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=0.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-1)(0)=2\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=2
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-3)(2)+(2)(0)=-4\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=2
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=2$, $x_2=2$, $x_3=0$, which means

$$
2a_1+(2)a_2+(0)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(2)+(2)+(0)=4.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}14 \\ -48 \\ 8\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}14 \\ -48 \\ 8\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{2} \\ - 2 x_{2} \\ 2 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3 x_{3} \\ - 11 x_{3} \\ x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}14 \\ -48 \\ 8\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{2} - 11 x_{3} \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{2} + x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}14 \\ -48 \\ 8\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=14 \\ - 2 x_{2} - 11 x_{3} &=-48 \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{2} + x_{3} &=8\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -48 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & 8\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -48 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & 8\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -48 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -48\end{array}\right] && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & -15 & -60\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 14 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=\left(- \frac{1}{15}\right)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=14 \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=-6 \\ x_{3} &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=4.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-2)(4)=-6\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=2
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(1)(2)+(3)(4)=14\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=0
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=0$, $x_2=2$, $x_3=4$, which means

$$
0a_1+(2)a_2+(4)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(0)+(2)+(4)=6.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 29 \\ 25\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 3\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 5 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 29 \\ 25\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ 3 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- x_{2} \\ 5 x_{2} \\ 2 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ x_{3} \\ 0\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 29 \\ 25\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - x_{2} \\ 5 x_{2} + x_{3} \\ 3 x_{1} + 2 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 29 \\ 25\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} &=0 \\ 5 x_{2} + x_{3} &=29 \\ 3 x_{1} + 2 x_{2} &=25\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 29 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & 25\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 29 \\ 3 & 2 & 0 & 25\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 29 \\ 0 & 5 & 0 & 25\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-3)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 & 29 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & \frac{1}{5} & \frac{29}{5} \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & -4\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & \frac{1}{5} & \frac{29}{5} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=(-1)R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - x_{2} &=0 \\ x_{2} + \frac{x_{3}}{5} &=\frac{29}{5} \\ x_{3} &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=4.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)(4)=\frac{29}{5}\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=5
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-1)(5)+(0)(4)=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=5
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=5$, $x_2=5$, $x_3=4$, which means

$$
5a_1+(5)a_2+(4)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(5)+(5)+(4)=14.
$$
